name: Fern
quote: In its slumber, the earth recalls the sea.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Another day of work... Honestly, I don't really feel like it.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: As I gaze into the Urvogel's skull, the Urvogel's skull also gazes into me.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: And here I thought I can finally enjoy my 90% off wagyu bento from the convenience store... Turns out it's two days past expiration. It's totally rotten...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: My head is filled with thoughts about Velociraptor fangs... I can't sleep at all!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: People claiming to have found living trilobites are all liars, without exception. The "trilobites" they found are simply horseshoe crabs. One is a chelicerate, while the other is closer to mandibulates.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: When will my days of being broke come to an end? I can't even come up with enough change for subway rides...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor, did you stay up too late last night? Well... guess I shouldn't disturb you in your sleep.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I really shouldn't say this, but... Professor, can you come to the store with me? I was hoping you could help me buy something.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Oh?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Hmm... Are you okay, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: That tickles...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Are naps on duty allowed?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm Fern. Professor, would you give me a little financial support? Archaeological research is costly, you see.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: A strong focus is an essential quality for archaeologists.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Mountains can turn into oceans, but the evidence of past life will not be wiped out.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Archaeology isn't really a profitable business, but will you continue to support me?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: We're leaving? Where to?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: The investigation begins.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: It's over!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Mission complete.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Is there anything else for me to work on?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can't... anymore...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I don't really think I have any likable personality traits, to be honest... But I'm not going to turn you down since you've done so much for me. Let's form an oath together.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: I wonder why everyone enjoys going out on New Year's so much... Isn't it better to stay at home and sleep after so many days of hard work? Oh! I just remembered there's a discount event at the supermarket today!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Oh, these chocolates are expiring? Then we should finish them today! I'll help you! Eating expired food is fine for Dolls like me, after all.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I see couples flirting everywhere. Ugh, come on!

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Skeletons won't scare me as I've been working with them every day. Perhaps you can try something else?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Don't look at me like that... It's just my habit as an archaeologist. Besides, plenty of people must have tried reassembling chicken bones in restaurants, right?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday. It's a strange gift, but... The nautilus is quite precious. It's one of the few animals that has been prospering on Earth for billions of years. Please take good care of it.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Staring at specimens and fossils all day long and recording the observations... It's indeed too boring for the average person, but this is the most basic of basics for an archaeologist.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
I'm particularly interested in collecting two kinds of items. One of them is fossils of flora and fauna to birds and dinosaurs. The other is discount vouchers and food coupons. They help me minimize my expenses, because I'm literally broke...
Ugh, when will I have a decent meal again?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Professor, can you lend me some money? I only need a little... It's an embarrassing favor to ask for, but you know how poor archaeologists can get.
Oh fine, I'll tell you! It's because I just bought a new tool. They are so nicely designed after all, I couldn't help it!
... Or maybe you can just buy me a bento?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
You should have some basic knowledge about this too. Be it mammals or reptiles, we all originated from the sea. The human ancestors bravely climbed out of the sea, and they made considerable sacrifices to survive. 
In other words, humanity would not have made it this far without the courage and the willingness to make sacrifices. What do you think?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Today's work is almost over.
Since it's not too late in the evening yet, can we go shopping together... They're having discounts today!
Also, help me with the shopping bags, please!

career:
The AA2 is a 42Lab-developed archaeological Doll designed to address the needs of science research teams. The AA2 possesses dedicated read-write memory which stores a large amount of information related to archaeology, including natural sciences, engineering, and humanities. Therefore, AA2s are often tasked with supporting the vast majority of special archaeological work.

As a special Doll customized by Frise International Joint Scientific Research Association for 42Lab, almost all of Fern's software is designed to store, retrieve, and analyze information. Even ignoring the archaeological aspect, she's still a mobile library in her own right.

In 2058, in order to backup and organize the archaeological data that Fern had accumulated in her years abroad, 42Lab transferred her back from the Scientific Research Association supposedly for maintenance and testing. They requested that she participate in Project Neural Cloud as part of the backup process.
infoStories:
Fern's position at the Frise International Joint Scientific Research Association was very special. No matter what direction an exploration team wanted to go in, they'd want to bring her along. This led to Fern's schedule being constantly full, with basically no time for herself. This continued until Fern unfortunately ended up making an error during an operation.

Due to her love for archaeology, Fern would never reject work, no matter how much she had scheduled. However, for safety reasons, the administrative staff at the Association for Scientific Expeditions customized a monthly schedule for her to prevent such dangerous situations from recurring.

With an abundance of free time now available, Fern found a very good money-burning hobby—traveling. When she had no work assigned, she decided to visit different places to observe and learn.

Even in this era of advanced technology and development, not everything has been digitized. Fern intends to visit locations with information not yet in the system, such as remote areas where information only travels by word of mouth, to fill in gaps in her knowledge and prepare for future archaeological operations.

Thus, despite a high salary and numerous bonuses granted to her by the Scientific Research Association and 42Lab, Fern often finds herself destitute. She has even prepared a special little box to hold supermarket coupons and other money saving measures.

Data transfers are not the only way for Fern to learn. Other than traveling, Fern also likes to collect books. Even though e-books are very popular, like many people, Fern still adores thumbing through paper books. Peering into a new world through the words on thin paper is like searching out a lost civilization from shards of broken tiles. Absolutely fascinating.

Because of her love of books, Fern came up with the idea of writing for herself. Using pen and paper to jot down her experiences and insights like a diary, instead of just inputting data into the system.

By the eve of her visit to 42Lab, she had written millions of words worth of paper records which she stored in the Scientific Research Association's dormitory. She hopes that one day these records can enter the association's library. She doesn't even need to have them published, just having them available for the next generation is enough for her.

For scientist Dolls like Fern, combat was not a consideration for their design. Their limited space must prioritize specialized equipment over weapons and combat frameworks. Fern didn't even carry self-defense equipment like humans do—Dolls do have a certain baseline level of strength after all.

However, after the 2056 ruin destruction incident sent shockwaves through the international community, all scientist Dolls were upgraded to improve their combat abilities. Particularly affected by the incident, Fern specially commissioned 42Lab to upgrade her mattock to military standards.

"The next time I meet those scumbags who trample over history for a quick buck, I'll smash them down with my own hands!!!!!"
—42Lab Research Institute Security Monitor, Abnormal Sound Reading Record

If there was anyone who wants to leave Magrasea and return to reality, Fern would definitely be on the list. She didn't originally plan to join Project Neural Cloud at all. When she was notified to return to 42Lab for maintenance and testing, she had just arrived at her hotel in Dublin and planned to go to a ruin site the following day.

"Professor, I don't... well... I have to admit, I'm a little on edge. This, ahh, is honestly really bugging me."
"There's no point in comforting me. What can even be found in Magrasea? Every inch of this place, all its 1s and 0s, is born from modern times. There's not even a sliver of historical value. I'm not complaining! ...I guess I am complaining, but... *sigh*. Let's finish up here quickly, Professor."
—Doll Psychological Evaluation Recording
oathDesc: A special name has come up during the long journey from the Cambrian to the Triassic Period.

projections.name: Archaeologist
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"What this lamp will illuminate are secrets that have been buried for thousands, or perhaps millions of years. She was made to unearth these secrets one by one."

projections.name: Narrator
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"She returns those dusty years, and their corresponding weight, to civilization."

skinList.name: Fossilbusters
skinList.desc:
From Cyber Media's "Theater Retro" series, which faithfully reproduces scenes from classic works, providing a brand new experience for you and your Dolls.
"The whole city needs my help now, but I'm just an archaeologist!"

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"(Sob) ...I'm doomed! Help me, Professor! Or else I'll have to pinch food from you next month!"

skinList.name: Geis of the Fianna
skinList.desc:
Mythical Journey—Within a mysterious domain, the Dolls lose themselves in ancient myths, searching for the lingering echoes of legendary heroes.
The clouds streak by day after day, until at last they arrive at the place where the wind rests, and a hero pledges an oath of sealing, sword in hand.
"With this unbreakable vow, I make the promise of an ancient hero—I shall defend these traces of life long past."
